rationale: For the existing ESN, when estimated load is zero, both the contextual drive and direct-context readout vanish. Equal loaded prefixes therefore give identical subsequent outputs even when proprioceptive progress differs. The teacher has progress-dependent state release. A synthetic diagnostic confirms this expressiveness limitation but does not establish a physically realized task failure.
change: Use the already implemented fixed random context-dependent leak gate with default multiplier range0.05..2.0; same128 reservoir units, same18 public observation fields and constrained linear readout. Input/recurrent/gate weights remain fixed in ESN. No teacher at deployment, new observation, geometry, gate, actuator or filter change.
paired_controls: Identical fixed gate for retrained memoryless128 ablation and feature-matched MLP/RNN. Their existing selected learning rates across3seeds are reused; both loss variants,4000updates. Existing ordinary and ungated neural baselines remain. All families may use the same revised48cap; actual compute differs and is disclosed.
new_jobs: Per seed: gated ESN point/temporal each12ridge candidates; gated memoryless12ridge; matched gated MLP/RNN point/temporal each one4000update fit. Three seeds,21models. ESN cumulative48; memoryless24; pooled ordinary+matched MLP/RNN each14 candidates perseed.
data: Unchanged18 real train and6 whole-identity validation trajectories. Synthetic probe is not training data; no development or sealed histories enter fitting.
development: All21models x same8 public development identities =168 episodes, managed simulation slots; all failures retained. Shared variant choice across all3seeds follows the existing strict/task/horizon/penetration/RMSE/torque ranking. Never choose a lucky seed.
